name: Kanda Mitsuteru
source:
A rival.
The leader of a large group of delinquents within the school. A cruel and brutal young man who is willing to do whatever it takes to get what he wants. Contrary to this, he is also exceptionally charismatic and intelligent, and climbed to the top of his gang through cunning.
